questions.question_text: Simplify $\dfrac{\cot x}{\sec x}$ in terms of primary trigonometric functions.

options.why: Inverted the fraction ratio upside down.
Incorrectly cancelled the cosine factors to obtain $1/\sin x$, then inverted that result to obtain $\sin x$.

questions.solution_text: $\dfrac{\cot x}{\sec x} = \dfrac{\cos x/\sin x}{1/\cos x} = \dfrac{\cos^2 x}{\sin x}$
